profile.name: Pierre-Stéphane Voltaire
profile.about: Senior Full-Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer with over 7 years of experience building scalable web applications and cloud-native services. Strong expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Node.js, Java, Go, and Python, along with extensive backend development experience. Proficient in architecting microservices and serverless solutions, optimizing databases, implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging AWS cloud platforms, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Experienced in leading cloud migration initiatives and mentoring development teams on cloud-native architectures.

experiences.name: Nasdaq
summary: **Maintained and enhanced a cloud-native PHP/Python platform** running on **AWS Lambda**, diagnosing and resolving production bugs to ensure platform reliability and continuity of service.

**Owned and evolved end-to-end Terraform infrastructure stacks** provisioning full AWS environments, with **Ansible**, **Packer**, and **Python** as core automation layers; participated in live incident response to resolve AWS performance and networking failures.

**Built and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines** and introduced **AI skills and agents** with GitHub Copilot instructions to facilitate and standardize code reviews, code generation, and documentation.

**Designed and implemented a scheduling capability** for an enterprise regulatory reporting and risk management SaaS platform using **Amazon S3**, **EventBridge**, and **SQS**, enabling asynchronous event-driven processing.
**Designed and implemented bidirectional data synchronization** between **Amazon S3** and **Azure Blob Storage**, enabling reliable cross-cloud data exchange between AWS and Azure environments.

experiences.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group
summary: **Developed high-availability GitLab backup solution** using **FastAPI** (Python) and **Redis** caching, protecting **1,000+ repositories** with scalable multi-instance architecture deployed via **ArgoCD** and **Kustomize**.

**Architected cloud migration strategies** for legacy **Java** and **.NET** applications, redesigning monolithic systems into serverless **Lambda** functions and containerized microservices, achieving significant cost savings through **KEDA** autoscaling and resource optimization.
**Optimized database performance** during critical outages by identifying and resolving low-performing **Oracle** queries on **RDS**, ensuring system stability and improved response times.
**Built secure configuration management tools** using **Node.js** and **Python Lambda** functions integrated with **Jenkins**, streamlining secret management and application deployment processes.
**Automated EKS cluster upgrades** for **20+ production clusters** using **GitLab CI** and **Terraform**, eliminating manual operations and **reducing AWS extended support costs by $6K/month**.

**Architected and implemented CI/CD pipelines** using **GitLab CI**, **CodeDeploy**, and custom **Python**/**Bash**/**PowerShell** automation scripts, **reducing production deployment time by 94%** from hours to minutes.

**Led security hardening initiatives** during AWS migration, **aligning with SOC 2 compliance** by enhancing network security with HTTPS and **ACM** certificates, encrypting **EFS** storage with **AWS KMS**, and utilizing **IAM** for access control enforcement.
**Migrated legacy source control systems** from **TFS** and **SVN** to **GitLab**, ensuring seamless version control transition and implementing **GitOps** workflows.
**Optimized artifact management** across **Sonatype Nexus**, **GitLab**, and **Amazon ECR** for **Java**, **.NET**, **Python** packages and **Docker** images, improving deployment reliability.
**Provisioned cloud environments** for greenfield applications using **CloudFormation**, **Terraform**, and **AWS CDK**, enabling rapid scalable deployments.
**Implemented comprehensive monitoring solutions** integrating **Datadog APM** into cloud-native applications, **accelerating troubleshooting** and improving performance visibility.
**Mentored development teams** on cloud-native architectures, guiding the adoption of serverless patterns and Docker-based solutions while maintaining hands-on development of critical services.

**Implemented comprehensive tests** using **Jest** and integration tests, ensuring code quality through automated CI/CD pipelines with **GitHub Actions**.
